title: A multi-objective optimization framework integrating ICSL deep learning for forecasting and scheduling emergency medical supply demand in public health emergencies.
summary: The open Nature article's Methods and Results establish an ICSL deep-learning demand forecast tied to Wuhan emergency-supply data and a multi-objective scheduling model; the reported improvements are benchmarked against LSTM and BP baselines.
ai_technology: ICSL combines IVMD, PCR, CNN and LSTM components to forecast emergency-supply demand.
organization: Guangxi Key Laboratory of International Join for China-ASEAN Comprehensive Transportation

evidence.tested: Wuhan data forecasts for 17 cities feed an urgency/time/cost scheduling model; accuracy improves over LSTM and BP baselines.
evidence.unknown: Baseline comparisons and component ablations support the bounded forecasting result, while the source states generalizability limits.
evidence.ai_role: ICSL combines IVMD, PCR, CNN and LSTM components to forecast emergency-supply demand.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
